ci_method: 95% paired t over seeds (n-1 df); bootstrap percentile CI over seeds as a check
total_cost_definition: holding + repair + logistics + expedite + AOG penalty (capital excluded)

labels.immediate_fill_rate: Immediate fill rate (share of requested qty issued from local serviceable stock at need time)
labels.aog_hours: Expected material-related downtime hours per year (material AOG hours, config economics.aog_hour_definition)
labels.aog_events: Material-related downtime events per year (merged per aircraft)
labels.backorder_unit_hours: Material shortage exposure (unfilled request-unit-hours per year)
labels.spare_capital_aed: Spare capital, AED (time-average value of owned spares; NOT part of annual cost)
labels.total_annual_cost_aed: Total annual cost, AED = holding + repair + logistics + expedite/AOG-route + AOG penalty (capital excluded)
labels.holding_cost_aed: Holding cost, AED/yr (carrying rate x spare capital)
labels.expedite_cost_aed: Emergency logistics + AOG-route fees (exchange, loan, borrow, local buy premium, robbery labour), AED/yr
labels.aog_penalty_aed: AOG penalty, AED/yr (hourly rate x hours + fixed cost per event; planning scenario)
labels.aog_event_cost_aed: Fixed AOG-event cost part of the penalty, AED/yr
labels.aog_hourly_penalty_aed: Hourly part of the AOG penalty, AED/yr
labels.purchase_spend_aed: Purchase spend, AED/yr (consumption replenishment; not in total cost)
labels.aog_hours_expiry_artefact: Downtime hours/yr from needs left unfilled after an earmarked shelf-life shipment expired on arrival (engine bug, reported)
labels.aog_hours_excl_expiry_artefact: Expected material-related downtime hours/yr excluding the expiry-on-arrival engine artefact

penalty_sensitivity_definition: hourly AOG rate x m, fixed per-event cost unchanged
